versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-history skill.
- Enables searching and reading past coding-agent conversations (OpenCode, Claude Code, etc.) using the `ochist` CLI.
- Supports powerful grep and filtering across all local agent histories, scoped by project or globally.
- Provides commands for session listing, metadata overview, part-level deep-dives, and source management.
- Designed to avoid context bloat with paging and pipe-friendly outputs; fully read-only and safe.
- Optimizes AI workflows by checking previous discussions before repeating research or codebase exploration.
